scope: Arithmetic completeness of terminal and two-helper relaxations, incremental membership and undo, canonical shard exclusions, and agreement of early pruning under node limits.
notes: Unpruned BFS enumerates reachable states by the number of distinct non-target helpers, using independently implemented arithmetic and closure. Whole-instance decisions and original-vs-optimized per-shard decisions are checked separately.
Terminal checks run over reachable prefixes and five synthetic ban patterns, including banning all actual final-step winners and all other values.
Two-helper coverage checks need only avoid false negatives. A positive relaxed test need not have a reachable pair. Cases include a 64-target mask and the maximum dense-domain bound.
Dynamic membership tests compare full reversible tables with their pre-extension copies, including every partners row. Two 0-to-1-to-many updates to a value in one extension are explicitly counted.
For 1500 capped searches early versus late pair pruning must agree on status, interruption and charged nodes, including individual shard marks.
Validated by code inspection and finite differential testing, not an exhaustive proof over all inputs.
